messages:
maya: CI is red on master — ~8 failing tests in `node-tests:kv-integration`. All failing with connection reset to mock-kv-service under load. job: circleci/containers/98765

sam: saw this too. reran the job once (98765) -> still failing.

ci-bot: [circleci] Re-run triggered for job 98765 by @sam

sam: paste of failing log:```
ERR kv-client: write tcp 10.0.0.5:41234->10.0.0.9:6379: write: connection reset by peer
stack: client.go:123 client.go:87
```

liam: looking at mock-kv pods in CI cluster — saw restarts. probably container-level crash/restart vs app-level close. can someone check container logs + exit reason?

ira: checking now, kube shows mock-kv-ci-*/0 restarted 3x in last 12m, last reason: OOMKilled. logs show many goroutines stuck in accept loop before crash.

devops-bot: Deploy event: mock-kv-image:v2.1.0 rolled out to ci-network at 12:34 UTC (sha256:abcd1234)

maya: ah — we bumped mock-kv image this morning as part of infra/image-updates. likely regression.

liam: can we bisect which change caused it? image diff between v2.0.0 and v2.1.0 shows net listener change + new default ulimit removal. I can run a quick bisect of the image build steps.

sam: temporary workaround: pin CI to v2.0.0 so other PRs can land. open PR to override image tag in circleci config?

maya: I'll open the PR: small change to .circleci/services.yaml to pin mock-kv:```yaml
services:
  mock-kv:
    image: registry.internal/mock-kv:v2.0.0
```
I'll mark it rollout-critical and request fast-track.

liam: for bisect: run `./scripts/ci/bisect-image.sh --service mock-kv --from v2.0.0 --to v2.1.0 --test node-tests:kv-integration` — should narrow down the layer. I'm starting it now.

liam: update: bisect shows failure introduced when we removed the explicit `ulimit -n 65536` in the Dockerfile (layer 7). On CI containers, default fd limit is low and under concurrent test load it hits fd exhaustion -> OOM when goroutines allocate buffers.

liam: fast fix: reintroduce ulimit and bump net.core.somaxconn at container startup. rebuilding image as v2.1.1.

devops-bot: Build pipeline: mock-kv-image:v2.1.1 (sha256:ef01cde5) completed and pushed.

ci-bot: [circleci] Re-run triggered for job 98765 by @maya

ci-bot: [circleci] Job 98765 completed — all tests passed :tada:

maya: merging the pin PR to unblock anything still pointing at v2.1.0, will follow up with a short postmortem and a note in infra/changes about reverting the Dockerfile removal.

ira: filing an incident note in #incidents with timeline and root cause (fd limits + missing ulimit in image) so we don't regress.

sam: thanks everyone — feel free to @eng-sre if we need a broader alerting rule for mock-kv restarts.

liam: adding a healthcheck that fails faster on fd exhaustion and an alert (restarts > 2/10m). will PR shortly.
